aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:868.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Manager Production is responsible for advancing and managing all production-related aspects of assigned events and shows. This role leads the production team in developing and executing comprehensive event plans that align with contractual requirements and production objectives. The Production Manager oversees show budgets, tracks and monitors expenses to ensure financial accountability, and ensures that all production, venue, and artist requirements are met. This position plays a critical role in delivering successful events by coordinating resources, both internally and externally, managing logistics, and maintaining a high standard of execution and client satisfaction. Essential Functions Serve as the primary technical contact/liaison for the venue. Assist all parties in determining production capabilities and estimating show costs for each event. Advance and coordinate all technical aspects of events including artist/client logistics, production rentals, stage labor, parking, runners, security, hospitality needs and preparation of day of show schedule. Advance all aspects within the terms and budget parameters of artist/client contract. Negotiate solutions to obstacles ensuring contract and budget adherence. Track/document all production expenses. Communicate the advance information in a timely manner to all personnel, vendors, and artist contacts, confirming all information and instructions are accurate and understood. Oversee day of show production from load in through load out. Ensure quality operation and preparedness from all production departments. Resolve production issues as they arise. Direct typical day of show operations such as hospitality fulfillment, security meetings, guest list. Maintain the production schedule and run of show. Supervise production staff and ensure appropriate breaks and meals are taken in accordance with local rules. Prepare/present all production expenses for settlement. May be responsible for show settlement after the show has concluded. Makes sure that artist(s) are paid accordingly. The Production Manager will also close out the show and submit all pertinent information to accounting. Assist in recruiting, hiring and training of production staff as required, Supervise, manage, and evaluate production staff, including time and attendance, task management and conflict resolution. Determine staffing needs for each production and schedule accordingly. Review, approve and submit payroll. Maintain and safeguard the technical assets of the venue through the development and implementation of routine preventative maintenance schedules and inventories. May be responsible for production management/promoter representation at other locations, venues, or projects as directed. Learn more about working at Axiom . embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:c0efa13.description: Company Overview Join a global leader in cloud-native solutions and IoT innovation, driving secure and scalable platforms across industries. We collaborate closely with international partners, including China-based teams, to deliver cutting-edge technologies for connected ecosystems. jobgether-jobgether:lever:88f845cb-7909-.title: Software Engineer - Performance and Tools
jobgether-jobgether:lever:88f845cb-7909-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Engineer - Performance and Tools based in the United States. This role is ideal for a software engineer who enjoys solving complex performance challenges and building tools that improve enterprise application reliability. You will work across software development, performance engineering, test automation, observability, databases, and cloud-native systems. The position combines hands-on engineering with investigation of application, infrastructure, and database bottlenecks. You will help develop synthetic test data solutions, create sophisticated performance test frameworks, and validate system scalability under demanding conditions. Working closely with Development, QA, DevOps, and SRE teams, you’ll turn performance insights into practical engineering improvements. The role also offers opportunities to apply AI/ML techniques and modern observability practices to performance testing and analysis. As part of a collaborative remote engineering environment, you’ll contribute directly to the reliability and scalability of technology supporting the healthcare industry. Performance engineering: Design, develop, and execute performance testing scenarios covering load, stress, spike, endurance/soak, volume, and scalability testing. Performance troubleshooting: Investigate application performance issues by analyzing application, infrastructure, and database bottlenecks and identifying root causes. Test data engineering: Support development and quality teams with test data requirements, maintain internal synthetic data generation tools, and enhance their capabilities. Test automation: Develop, maintain, and optimize performance scripts, test frameworks, and supporting automation. CI/CD integration: Integrate performance testing into continuous integration and deployment pipelines to make performance validation part of the software delivery lifecycle. Observability: Incorporate monitoring and observability tools into performance analysis, using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts to diagnose issues. AI-enabled engineering: Develop solutions using an AI-centric approach and explore AI/ML techniques that can improve performance testing, analysis, and engineering workflows. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Development, QA, DevOps, and SRE teams to identify, communicate, and resolve performance and scalability issues. Performance reporting: Build performance reports and reporting frameworks and provide actionable recommendations for application optimization. Application scalability: Validate and improve the scalability, reliability, and performance of enterprise applications and cloud-native systems. Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities to improve performance engineering practices, tooling, automation, and overall testing efficiency. Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Professional experience: 3–8 years of experience spanning software development and performance testing or performance engineering. Python: Professional experience using Python for backend application development. JavaScript: Basic experience with JavaScript for frontend web development. SQL and databases: Experience with SQL, database design principles, query development and optimization, and database performance analysis. AI development tools: Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to produce high-quality engineering solutions. Performance testing: Practical understanding of performance engineering concepts and hands-on experience with one or more tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling, k6, Locust, NeoLoad, or BlazeMeter. Observability and monitoring: Experience with platforms such as Datadog, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, New Relic, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, AWS CloudWatch, or Google Cloud Monitoring.
